title: the Celtic mythos
audit_comment: THE CELTIC MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round five, print pp. 26-31: sixteen beings (Dagda, Arawn, Brigit, Cu Chulainn, Diancecht, Dunatis, Goibhnie, Lugh, Manannan Mac Lir, Math, Morrigan, Nuada, Oghma, Silvanus, the Master of the Hunt, the Pack of the Wild Hunt) - the druid doctrine of the robes, torc and cauldron, the Wild Hunt doctrine, the tathlum and the Torc of the Gods. Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The flagged eyeball cells: the Manannan trident drain fraction (one-fourth, garbled in both voices), the tathlum damage fraction (garbled in both voices), and the Morrigan charisma 21 or -1 (both print voices garble identically; the 1eonline transcription corroborates).

banner.title: the Celtic mythos - the D&DG walk round five, print pp. 26-31: sixteen beings from Dagda the dozen king to the Pack of the Wild Hunt - the druid doctrine of the feast-day sacrifices, the torc and the cauldron, seven greater gods, and the Wild Hunt itself.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 027-032; the second printing); the collation voices: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (djvu.txt + djvu.xml word geometry) and the 1eonline.info transcription (the Lugh S:23 and Morrigan charisma tie-breaks). The adjudications: the Dagda psionic class II (the 29px two-glyph IA word against the Termux I-slash), the Dagda magic-user/illusionist 15th in each and 20th bard (the IA recovery of the Termux fold), the Silvanus AC -4 and the 18 over 48 through-forests move (the IA recovery of fold-garbled lines), the Cu Chulainn 6-foot-4 and Math 5-foot-4 sizes (the foot-mark-as-1 decode of the printed 614 and 514 cells), the Cu Chulainn intelligence 17 (the Termux against the IA 1:97 misread), the Lugh strength 23 plus 5 plus 11 (the Termux and the transcription against the IA S:20 misread), the Lugh fighter slot kept as the printed 19th level ranger (both print voices; the transcription normalizes to fighter), the Nuada and Oghma 6-foot sizes (the IA clean read against the Termux ampersand garbles), the Goibhnie psionic VI (the 51px V-slash word), and the Morrigan charisma line 21 or -1 (the print variable-charisma cell, the transcription corroborating). Flagged for the physical-copy eyeball: the Manannan trident one-fourth drain and the tathlum damage fraction (both garbled in both voices).

bools.comment: Lugh long handed, god of generalities, a greater god

bools.name: dgeLughBorrowedAttribute
bools.comment: he is unique: he can use any one attribute of any being he has ever met

bools.name: dgeLughLargeHands
bools.comment: he appears as a tall man with very large hands

bools.name: dgeLughNoArmor
bools.comment: he never uses armor and depends on his one power to defeat his foe

bools.name: dgeLughDruidicalIdeal
bools.comment: he is a druidical ideal, casting druidical spells at the 30th level, unlimited

bools.name: dgeLughImmunities
bools.comment: he is immune to control, petrification, or paralyzation

bools.name: dgeManannanSeaGod
bools.comment: Manannan Mac Lir, god of the sea, a greater god

bools.name: dgeManannanRedBeard
bools.comment: this god appears as a large red-bearded man

bools.name: dgeManannanTridentDrains
bools.comment: his trident absorbs moisture from bodies it hits, draining one-fourth of the victim original hit points

bools.name: dgeManannanRetaliator
bools.comment: against the fire giants he uses the sword Retaliator, which kills every time it hits, magic save applicable, and does 3-30 plus strength even on a save

bools.name: dgeManannanSeaSummon
bools.comment: he calls on any non-godlike sea creature in numbers up to 50, arriving under their own power

bools.name: dgeManannanSaltWaterImmune
bools.comment: he is immune to any magical device attack while in salt water

bools.name: dgeMathMagicUser
bools.comment: Math, the magic-user, greatest of all the legendary wizards in Celtic myth

bools.name: dgeMathHearsBreezes
bools.comment: he has given himself the power to hear anything said in a breeze anywhere in the world

bools.name: dgeMathTorcBearer
bools.comment: he has been given a Torc of the Gods for what he has done for the gods

bools.name: dgeMathWaterRod
bools.comment: when forced to fight he uses a rod that turns any being touched into a pool of water, permanently, magic save applicable

bools.name: dgeMathPolymorphOthers
bools.comment: he enjoys using polymorph others to turn opponents into animals

bools.name: dgeMorriganWarGoddess
bools.comment: Morrigan, goddess of war, a lesser goddess

bools.name: dgeMorriganHideousFace
bools.comment: she appears as a well-proportioned woman with a hideous face - the printed charisma line reads 21 or -1

bools.name: dgeMorriganFear
bools.comment: she deprives all who face her of their courage, as the fear spell

bools.name: dgeMorriganInvisibleFight
bools.comment: she can fight invisibly

bools.name: dgeMorriganChaseSpeed
bools.comment: she travels on land at any speed she wishes when chasing a foe (the Variable move)

bools.name: dgeMorriganStrikesFleeing
bools.comment: she strikes dead a fleeing worshiper 5 percent of the time when watching, 10 percent per battle

bools.name: dgeMorriganTwoSpears
bools.comment: her two spears, red-headed and yellow-headed, strike for 3-36 each and never miss

bools.name: dgeMorriganMagicImmune
bools.comment: she is immune to attacks by magic-using beings not of godlike power while in battle

bools.name: dgeMorriganDemiGoddesses
bools.comment: her servants include four demi-goddesses of war, Fen, Neman, Badb and Macha, identical in all regards save 200 hit points each

bools.name: dgeNuadaSilverHand
bools.comment: Nuada, god of war, god of the Silver Hand, a greater god

bools.name: dgeNuadaArtificialHand
bools.comment: he appears as a man with an artificial silver hand

bools.name: dgeNuadaWeaponBonus
bools.comment: he gives any weapon he holds a +3 bonus to hit and double its damaging power

bools.name: dgeNuadaDancingHand
bools.comment: in battle he detaches the silver hand, which enters battle as a dancing sword hitting for 6-36

bools.name: dgeNuadaFendingSword
bools.comment: the +5 sword fends off any 3 weapons against its master, however powerful, and still attacks

bools.name: dgeNuadaWrestles
bools.comment: he demands his enemies wrestle him; the winner stays, the loser leaves the battle

bools.name: dgeNuadaEqualStrength
bools.comment: his strength is such that facing any being he has strength equal to that being plus his own

bools.name: dgeNuadaControlImmune
bools.comment: the god is immune to any type of magical control spell

bools.name: dgeOghmaBinder
bools.comment: Oghma, god of knowledge, The Binder, Patron of all Bards, a greater god

bools.name: dgeOghmaAgedMan
bools.comment: Oghma looks like an aged, white-haired man

bools.name: dgeOghmaBestWrestler
bools.comment: he is the best wrestler of all the gods, their champion against giants

bools.name: dgeOghmaCreativePatron
bools.comment: he is patron of things creative and beautiful in man and woman alike

bools.name: dgeOghmaSeeksGifted
bools.comment: his love of song, story and poetry brings him to earth seeking especially gifted people from hold to hold

bools.name: dgeOghmaAnswerMachine
bools.comment: he can answer any question after a short period of study - the more difficult, the longer it takes

bools.name: dgeOghmaSecretNames
bools.comment: he knows the secret name of any non-godlike creature; knowing it lets one control the being or make it die, save vs death applicable

bools.name: dgeOghmaVariableStrength
bools.comment: the asterisked strength: facing any being he has strength equal to that being plus his own (the printed See below)

bools.name: dgeOghmaImprisonsDemons
bools.comment: Oghma is known as The Binder for forcing demons and devils into his special prison until he wishes them out

bools.name: dgeSilvanusForestGod
bools.comment: Silvanus, god of the forests and nature, a greater god

bools.name: dgeSilvanusLongLegs
bools.comment: Silvanus looks like a man with very long legs

bools.name: dgeSilvanusVoiceControl
bools.comment: he can control any number of animals and creatures of the forest with the sound of his voice

bools.name: dgeSilvanusPlants
bools.comment: he makes plants grow and/or shrink at any rate he wills

bools.name: dgeSilvanusLeafArmor
bools.comment: he wears armor made of leaves that act like +5 plate mail; the +5 wooden mallet strikes for 5-50

bools.name: dgeSilvanusWolfhound
bools.comment: a giant wolfhound fights at his side, so fast it takes all the damage meant for its master, but cannot block spells

bools.name: dgeSilvanusGroveProtector
bools.comment: he is a protector of the druid places: groves, villages, colleges and woodland paths

bools.name: dgeMasterOfTheHunt
bools.comment: the Master of the Hunt, the huge black-skinned man with antlers

bools.name: dgeMasterGreenEyes
bools.comment: the Master has jet black skin and glowing green eyes

bools.name: dgeMasterBlackLeather
bools.comment: his head is crowned by stag antlers and he wears a suit of black leather

bools.name: dgeMasterNeverSpeaks
bools.comment: the Master never speaks

bools.name: dgeMasterRunsBehind
bools.comment: he runs a few feet behind his pack and sounds his horn every 1 mile increment

bools.name: dgePackGreenFire
bools.comment: the hounds have licks of green fire for tongues and green fire for eyes, casting the eerie glow but doing no damage

bools.name: dgePackWaitsForHunters
bools.comment: the beasts never attack the hunted until all the beings drawn into the Hunt have had their chance to kill

bools.name: dgePackTakesOverIfKilled
bools.comment: if the pack is killed the Master battles the being

bools.name: dgePackDeathsUnnoticed
bools.comment: the death of any member goes unnoticed by the rest and disappears after the battle

bools.name: dgeHuntManifestation
bools.comment: the Wild Hunt exists in all lands where druids and their deities dwell - a physical manifestation of life force

bools.name: dgeHuntOneForm
bools.comment: it always takes on the same form: one huge black-skinned antlered man and his pack of hounds

bools.name: dgeHuntSummonedByEvil
bools.comment: the Hunt appears whenever there is evil in the land - an evil temple, a 12th level evil priest, or a grossly evil act

bools.name: dgeHuntPursuitNoise
bools.comment: the noise of the howling dogs or the Master horn can be heard for miles in the night

bools.name: dgeHuntPursuersJoin
bools.comment: any being actively pursuing the noise becomes part of the Hunt when they sight the pack and its master

bools.name: dgeHuntTwoRoles
bools.comment: beings taken into the Hunt become the hunters or the hunted

bools.name: dgeHuntNeverEntersBuildings
bools.comment: the Hunt passes close by the source of evil but never enters a building, passing within inches

bools.name: dgeHuntOnePerNight
bools.comment: there is only one Hunt on the Prime Material Plane on any given night, drawn to the greatest evil in the Celtic area

bools.name: dgeHuntKillsOrDisappears
bools.comment: if the Hunt finds a being to hunt, it attacks to kill and disappears at its summoning source

bools.name: dgeHuntBigGameFallback
bools.comment: if no one becomes the hunted after ten miles, the pack turns on the nearest big game creature

bools.name: dgeHuntCompelledAlignment
bools.comment: hunters must attack the quarry even against their alignment - paladins might have to attack helpless women

bools.name: dgeHuntEternal
bools.comment: the Master and pack can be slain, only to reappear the next night - the force creating the Hunt is eternal

bools.name: dgeHuntKeepsPace
bools.comment: the magic of the Hunt sweeps along its members, mounted or on foot, to keep the hound pace

bools.name: dgeHuntFlies
bools.comment: the Hunt pursues on the ground but can run right into the air over obstacles or difficult terrain

bools.name: dgeHuntDeathMelee
bools.comment: when the hunted is run down there is an instant melee to the death; all fight to the death, no holding back

bools.name: dgeHuntEscape
bools.comment: the only escapes: run out of the 10 mile radius, elude the pack until morning, or slay the Master and his pack

bools.name: dgeHuntSightingResnare
bools.comment: any being that has been part of the Hunt has a 50% chance of becoming ensnared again with every sighting of the Master and his pack

bools.name: dgeTathlumWeapon
bools.comment: the tathlum: a weapon of war anyone of the Celtic religions can make - an enemy head coated with lime into a rock hard ball

bools.name: dgeTathlumSunshine
bools.comment: thrown at friends of the former head owner under bright sunshine, it damages up to a fraction of the original hit points (the fraction garbles in both voices - flagged)

bools.name: dgeTathlumOnceOnly
bools.comment: the tathlum is usable only once

bools.name: dgeTorcOfTheGods
bools.comment: the Torc of the Gods, made by Goibhnie: the holder can shape change or polymorph others

bools.name: dgeTorcRareMetals
bools.comment: the Torc is like the other druidical torcs but made of rare metals with a large gem of random type set into the front

tables.name: the ability grid
col_comments: The strength cells (the Master reads the printed S:18(00)(+3, +6); the Pack monster row reads the all-sentinel line)

The parenthesized strength damage bonus cells (Math the printed +2; Oghma the asterisked 14 - the See below equal-plus-own doctrine)

col_comments: The roster ordinal cells (the print order, Dagda through the Pack)
The print page cells (26-31, the folio offset PRINT = PDF - 1)

The in-each cells (1 = a printed Nth level in each class line: Dagda magic-user/illusionist 15, Oghma both slots, Silvanus cleric/druid 14)
The Wild Hunt cells (1 = a member of the Hunt roster: the Master and the Pack; the fourteen mythos beings read 0)
